mike (engineering): Draft release notes + internal announce ready. Target EU cutover window 03/27 02:00-04:00 UTC. Quick eyes on pin/rollback wording?

sara (product): scanning now. do we have canary thresholds spelled out?

ana (eng-sre): @mike call out exact pins: model + infra (helps ops).

mike (engineering): adding: Pinned model: redwood/llm-3b@v1.4.2 (quantized-INT4). Fallback: redwood/llm-3b@v1.4.1. Infra: eu-dedicated-gpu-pool-7.

elaine (docs): I can polish bullets and internal blurb. paste the short announce paragraph?

sara (product): Draft blurb: "Were rolling v1.4.2 to EU; improves tail latency and lowers token cost ~12%. Canary 03/27 02:00 UTC; auto-fallback to v1.4.1 if thresholds exceeded."

daniel (oncall): Need explicit thresholds for runbook. numbers?

mike (engineering): Proposed thresholds:
- Errors: >= 3% 5xx or malformed outputs over 5m -> abort/rollback
- Latency: p95 > 700ms sustained for 10m -> abort/rollback
- Quality: eval score drop > 2% on canary prompt set -> rollback

ana (eng-sre): Add canary safety: stop if failed shards >1 or GPU OOM rate >0.5% across pool. Start traffic cap 5%.

mike (engineering): Canary plan: 5% traffic for 30m, then 25% for 30m, then full. Auto-abort if any threshold tripped.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: job_id=deploy-1742105432-1 target=eu-dedicated-gpu-pool-7 model=redwood/llm-3b@v1.4.2

deploy-bot: Canary started  5% traffic. dashboard: https://console.redwood.internal/canary/1742105432

elaine (docs): Internal announce (short): "Heads-up: Rolling v1.4.2 to EU (canary 03/27 02:00 UTC). Improvements: lower tail latency, cost reductions. Canary staged; rollback thresholds defined. Oncall: @daniel, @ana. See canary dashboard for metrics."

sara (product): add: "Do not escalate to customers unless rollback occurs."

daniel (oncall): I'll prepare runbook snippet and quick rollback command:
```
# rollback to stable
deploy-bot rollback --job deploy-1742105432-1 --to redwood/llm-3b@v1.4.1
```

mike (engineering): Runbook note: automated abort pages engineers and marks job aborted. Manual rollback after 5m investigation unless P1.

ana (eng-sre): Please add postmortem template link to internal announce.

elaine (docs): Added link to templates and short summary section.

mike (engineering): Final checklist: release notes (elaine), pins declared (mike), thresholds in runbook (daniel), deploy queued (deploy-bot), internal copy ready (sara/elaine).

sara (product): I'll send internal announce T-30 and keep external comms embargoed until stage 3.

an a (eng-sre): infra +1 to embargo.

daniel (oncall): oncall ready. rollback command staged in pager message.

deploy-bot: Canary progress @5m: errors 0.4%, p95 310ms, GPU mem 78%

elaine (docs): Good so far. will post 30m checkpoint update.

sara (product): If 30m looks stable, I'll push external comms draft to comms channel.

mike (engineering): Closing thread; will update after checkpoint. :thumbsup:
